items.title: test(windows): isolate lifecycle deadlines from fixture bootstrap
items.summary: test(windows): isolate lifecycle deadlines from fixture bootstrap Full validation 36134179527, job 108068299614, consumed the one-second readiness budget before the native fixture reported its launch. Ordering and replacement assertions therefore tested machine startup speed instead of the lifecycle they described. Hold the policy clock during bootstrap in the ordering case. In the deadline case, start the unchanged real one-second clock after an actual HTTP response reports ready:false. Preserve process cleanup and replacement checks, and require the completed unready response in the timeout receipt.

items.title: fix(ui): show failed goal outcome checks (#158021)
items.summary: fix(ui): show failed goal outcome checks (#158021) ## What Problem This Solves Refs #157961. A saved Goal mutation can reach the Control UI's **Check outcome** recovery control after an unconfirmed ACK. If the idempotent replay fails without a definitive Gateway rejection (for example, `UNAVAILABLE`), `runGoalOperation` retained the saved receipt but explicitly cleared `chatError`. The user saw the same recovery banner with no explanation after clicking. This change shows the unknown-outcome guidance together with the concrete Gateway error. The original operation identity remains saved; the UI does not infer success from the current goal, invent a new mutation, or replay a chat turn. A definitive rejection still follows its existing retirement behavior. The reported already-settled server operation lacks a captured failing RPC response, so this PR addresses the source-proven *silent failure* path; it does not assert a cause or automatic dismissal for that separate observation. ## Evidence - **Isolated real-Gateway rendered proof (2026-09-25, head `aa7e2fd`):** A temporary browser harness launched a real Gateway on isolated state/port with a synthetic owner, active Goal, and unused fixture model provider. The rendered **Pause goal** control sent the real `sessions.goal.update`; Gateway responded `{ok:true,replayed:false}`. The browser WebSocket route withheld only that ACK. After the browser timeout, the rendered **Check outcome** control replayed **identical params and operation ID**; Gateway responded `{ok:true,replayed:true}`. The route then substituted synthetic `UNAVAILABLE` only on the return path. The patched UI displayed `Goal update not confirmed. Check its outcome before making another change. Synthetic receipt transport interrupted` and kept **Check outcome** enabled. `pnpm test:ui:e2e ui/src/e2e/goal-157961-real-proof.e2e.test.ts` — **1/1 passed**, 191.23 s command duration (8.179 s case). [Inspected after screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Olli0103/openclaw/evidence/goal-157961-20260925/after.png), [sanitized observations](https://github.com/Olli0103/openclaw/blob/evidence/goal-157961-20260925/after.json), and [reproduction harness/limitations](https://github.com/Olli0103/openclaw/tree/evidence/goal-157961-20260925). The harness was removed from the PR worktree after capture. This proves real Gateway replay plus controlled browser receipt failure, **not** a real network outage or the cause of the separate already-settled-operation observation. - **Rendered before comparison (old source branch, mock Gateway):** Temporarily restored the exact old catch (`setChatError(host, rejected ? formatUiError(error) : null)`) and ran the same committed browser regression scenario through the rendered **Check outcome** button with `UNAVAILABLE`. The selected case asserted `.chat-error` was absent and captured an [inspected before screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Olli0103/openclaw/evidence/goal-157961-20260925/before-mock.png): `pnpm test:ui:e2e ui/src/e2e/chat-goal-recovery.e2e.test.ts -t 'shows a failed Check outcome'` — **1/1 selected case passed**, 17.86 s command duration (1.241 s case). Source and test were restored clean after capture. This comparison uses a **mock Gateway**, not an identical real-Gateway before fixture: real-Gateway counterfactual attempts lost the banner after Gateway session-change refresh before the follow-up click and are not presented as successful proof. - **Source before/after assertion:** At the named non-definitive `runGoalOperation` catch, the old source called `setChatError(host, null)`; the new source emits the unknown-outcome guidance plus `formatUiError(error)`. The committed rendered regression asserts the new visible error after the same **Check outcome** action and would fail against the old catch. - **Rendered Control UI regression:** `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner ui/src/e2e/chat-goal-recovery.e2e.test.ts` — **6/6 passed**, 29.21 s command wall time; new browser case 1.246 s test time. The new case starts Resume through the rendered button, withholds its ACK, reloads, clicks the rendered **Check outcome** button, verifies the replay uses identical request params/operation ID, rejects it with `UNAVAILABLE`, and observes the Gateway error text on screen. The control remains available, no `chat.send` occurs, and another reload restores the saved recovery without sending a request automatically. Before the fix, the non-definitive catch set `chatError` to `null`, so the visible-error assertion would fail. - **Goal owner unit suite:** `pnpm test ui/src/pages/chat/chat-goals.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` — **31/31 passed**, 17.57 s command wall time, including successful receipt replay, scope isolation, definitive rejection, and expired recovery fences. - `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check ui/src/pages/chat/chat-goals.ts ui/src/e2e/chat-goal-recovery.e2e.test.ts` — passed. - `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint ui/src/pages/chat/chat-goals.ts ui/src/e2e/chat-goal-recovery.e2e.test.ts` — passed. - `node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs scripts/check-assertion-safety-ratchet.mts --base origin/main` — passed. - `git diff --check` — passed. - Independent autoreview (`--mode local --base origin/main --max-priority P1 --engine claude`) — scoped clean, no actionable P0/P1 findings. The preferred Codex CLI was unavailable on this host; Claude was the supported fallback. Reviewer uncertainty about the translation key/import was checked against `ui/src/i18n/locales/en-chat-goals.ts` and `ui/src/pages/chat/chat-goals.ts`. - `pnpm build` — **passed**, 23m28.7s locally, including the production Control UI build. - `pnpm check` — production, UI, extension, scripts, and root test typechecks passed; broad lint then reported `eslint(max-lines)` in **unchanged** `src/gateway/server-chat-metadata-lifecycle.integration.test.ts` (1002 > 1000) and `src/gateway/session-companion-ask.ts` (770 > 700). Remaining long-running lint stripes were stopped after that independent baseline failure, so **the overall local command did not pass**. The two changed files separately passed `oxfmt --check` and `oxlint` above. This PR did not alter either lint-failing file. - Upstream PR CI on head `aa7e2fd` — **all 3/3 `checks-ui` shards, all 9/9 `checks-ui-e2e` shards, `control-ui-i18n`, `PR context and evidence`, and `openclaw/ci-gate` passed**. The repository-wide local `pnpm test` was not run; the focused suites and the listed upstream matrix are the test evidence, not a claim of a full local test pass. ## Maintainer real-Gateway comparison Both captures below use the rebuilt Control UI served by an isolated real Gateway and synthetic operator/session. Pause committed successfully; its ACK was withheld. Check outcome replayed the identical operation and the Gateway returned success with `replayed: true`; the browser return path substituted a synthetic `UNAVAILABLE` for that check. With current main’s exact `chat-goals.ts` owner, the banner remained without an error. With this PR, the concrete failure was visible and the saved request remained available. A subsequent unmodified real replay cleared the banner and it stayed absent after reload on **both** versions. A normal confirmed Edit updated the objective with no recovery banner. Therefore this PR repairs failed-check visibility; no additional successful-replay reconciliation change is warranted by this reproduction. The original incident’s replay response is unavailable, so this remains Refs #157961 rather than an unsupported full-incident closure. No model invocation is needed for Pause/Edit or their receipt replay; no external provider was called. The temporary real-Gateway scenario passed for main-owner comparison (8.296 s case, 52.21 s command) and candidate (9.066 s case, 54.68 s command). Goal owner unit suite: 31/31, 6.11 s command. Focused rendered recovery suite: 6/6, 22.66 s command (new failed-check case 1.408 s). The temporary harness is not part of the PR. Simplification retained the existing owner-level +5 production lines and one +66-line browser regression; no new state or abstraction. ### Before: failed check silently retains recovery ![Before: silent failed check](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5893c7af-a46d-404f-8f85-3f819d85cd08) ### After: failed check explains the error ![After: visible failed check](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5d23955d-9136-4a59-a9df-2739ba5c09bc) ### Successful receipt replay clears recovery ![Successful receipt replay](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0435d495-cdb6-4419-ae12-82d6bf030200) ### Normal confirmed edit ![Normal confirmed edit](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1f1c1c63-e811-44a4-b5c9-62b6b77aa715) Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: AWS CloudWatch Omni納入AI代理品質測試，可比較模型與提示詞表現
items.summary: AWS擴充Amazon CloudWatch可觀測性服務，推出CloudWatch Omni，將AI代理與應用程式監控整合到同一環境。除了記錄延遲、詞元（Token）用量與工具呼叫等執行情況，CloudWatch Omni還能評估代理回答品質，並比較不同提示詞、模型與代理設定的結果，協助開發團隊找出版本變更後的品質退化問題。

items.title: Docker Cloud Sandboxes上線，AI代理環境可在本機與雲端雙向搬移
items.summary: Docker推出Cloud Sandboxes雲端沙箱服務，將原本在開發者電腦執行的Docker Sandboxes隔離環境延伸到Docker管理的雲端運算資源。開發者可讓AI程式開發代理在雲端執行大型程式修改、測試等工作，並使用sbx move指令，在本機與雲端之間搬移沙箱環境。

items.title: Anthropic動用近千Claude代理搜尋DNA，21小時找出新型ART酵素系統
items.summary: Anthropic公開生命科學研究團隊首批成果，近950個Claude AI代理搜尋大量DNA資料，找出過去未被描述的酵素系統ART（array-associated reverse transcriptases）。ART包含反轉錄酶、相鄰蛋白質與規律排列的DNA重複序列，DNA重複序列具有類似基因編輯工具CRISPR的排列特徵。ART的生物功能尚未確認，Anthropic已展開實驗研究。

items.title: Google AI代理PageBreak找出自家Web應用程式逾500個XSS漏洞
items.summary: Google近日公布內部AI代理PageBreak的漏洞研究成果，這套AI代理由Google產品安全團隊開發，用於尋找Google第一方Web應用程式的安全漏洞。目前PageBreak已在這些Web應用程式找出超過500個跨站指令碼（XSS）漏洞，部分漏洞出現在敏感網域。PageBreak找出疑似漏洞後，會交由專門的驗證工具執行實際酬載，確認漏洞能否成功利用。Google表示，這項驗證機制讓PageBreak的誤判率接近零。
